# QuotaPin 1.3.1

This patch release makes Windows package verification independent of PowerShell module auto-loading.

Windows package: `QuotaPin-1.3.1.exe`

macOS package: `QuotaPin-macOS-1.3.1.dmg`

Windows 10 version 2004 or later is supported on x64. Windows 11 ARM64 runs the same x64 package through native emulation and remains covered by the release gate.

- Fix an in-app Windows update failure that could occur after a package download when a detached Windows PowerShell 5.1 process could not resolve its module-provided hashing command.
- Use the same .NET SHA-256 implementation as the release trust boundary in both the in-app updater and public Windows bootstrap.
- Preserve the existing transactional update behavior: configuration and install ownership stay intact, and Codex is never closed or relaunched.
- Add a Windows PowerShell regression gate that disables module auto-loading and proves package hashing still succeeds.

If an older installation shows an update failure before it can install this fix, run Windows Quick Start once; it preserves the existing configuration and installation flavor.

Windows Quick Start:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

macOS Quick Start:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install-macos.sh | bash
```
